pluss::subsp::stats::ts::CorrPlotOptions¶

Options of the autocorrelation plots and payloads.

CorrPlotOptions selects the lags, the estimator and the confidence band.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

max_lag

std::int64_t

20

The highest lag plotted.

norm

ts::AcfNorm

Biased

Normalisation of the autocovariances (Biased or Unbiased).

demean

bool

true

Subtract the sample mean first.

include_zero_lag

bool

false

Include lag 0 (always 1) in the payload and the plot.

show_confidence_band

bool

true

Draw the white-noise band; with false the band limits in the payload are 0.

confidence_level

double

0.95

Level of the band: ±z/√n with z the normal quantile.

trace_width

float

1.2

Line width of the drawn stems.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
